mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMMUNITY_COMMENT ( COMMENT_NUM, COMMU_NUM, MEMBER_NUM, MEMBER_NAME, COMMENT_CONTENTS, COMMENT_DATE, PARENT_COMMENT_NUM ) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(COMMENT_NUM), 0) + 1 FROM COMMUNITY_COMMENT), #{commuNum}, #{memberNum}, #{memberName}, #{commentContents}, SYSDATE, #{parentCommentNum, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )
mapper.select: SELECT COMMENT_NUM, COMMU_NUM, MEMBER_NUM, MEMBER_NAME, COMMENT_CONTENTS, COMMENT_DATE, PARENT_COMMENT_NUM FROM COMMUNITY_COMMENT WHERE COMMENT_NUM = #{commentNum}

SELECT COMMENT_NUM, COMMU_NUM, MEMBER_NUM, MEMBER_NAME, COMMENT_CONTENTS, COMMENT_DATE, PARENT_COMMENT_NUM FROM COMMUNITY_COMMENT WHERE COMMU_NUM = #{commuNum} ORDER BY NVL(PARENT_COMMENT_NUM, COMMENT_NUM) DESC, -- 원댓글 기준 최신순 PARENT_COMMENT_NUM NULLS FIRST, -- 원댓글 먼저 COMMENT_DATE ASC -- 대댓글은 오래된 순

SELECT COMMENT_NUM, COMMU_NUM, MEMBER_NUM, MEMBER_NAME, COMMENT_CONTENTS, COMMENT_DATE, PARENT_COMMENT_NUM FROM COMMUNITY_COMMENT WHERE PARENT_COMMENT_NUM = #{parentCommentNum} ORDER BY COMMENT_DATE DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE COMMUNITY_COMMENT SET COMMENT_CONTENTS = #{commentContents}, COMMENT_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE COMMENT_NUM = #{commentNum}
